scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

potential_bias: frames the issue as a response-speed problem

interpretation_history.interpretation: The observation shows disputed bills for both ESTIMATED (1240) and ACTUAL (1785) read types, indicating that disputes are not limited to estimation substitution.
The tariff change log shows no recorded tariff changes, indicating that tariff alterations are not a source of the recent wrong bills.

Route completion for Aug‑Sep 2026 is 0.88 (88%) against a 0.95 target, with 9,200 manual read accounts, indicating field manual reads are below target and may be driving estimation substitution and disputes.
Dispute ticket count is 2440 with median response time 1.6 days and 90th percentile 2.8 days, within the 3‑day SLA, indicating the surge is in volume not response delay.
The dispute ticket volume rose sharply starting in August, with September showing 1,260 disputes, confirming the reported increase since August.
